[{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Hey, I just reconnected with an old college friend. It's been a while since we talked."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That sounds intriguing! How did you two get back in touch?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Actually, he stumbled upon my blog about mental health and reached out. We've been catching up a bit."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's so nice! Your blog must really resonate with people. How are you feeling about reconnecting?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"It's been nice, but it's also brought up a lot of past feelings and memories. I guess I'm a bit overwhelmed."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That makes sense. Old friendships can bring up a lot of emotions. How are you managing those feelings?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I'm trying to keep things in perspective and use what I've learned in therapy. It's just...sometimes it feels like too much."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's good that you're using your therapeutic tools. Have you talked to your therapist about it?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Not yet. We've been focusing more on my recent breakup and the tension with Jack, my boss-slash-partner."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That sounds like it keeps you pretty occupied. It might help to bring this up with your therapist too when you can."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"You're right. I think I just needed to talk it out first. Sometimes, these old connections feel a bit disruptive."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I understand that. It’s okay to feel that way. Maybe there's something positive this old friend can bring to your life again?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"True, he was really supportive back in college. It’s nice to have that kind of support again."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Absolutely! It's great that you have someone who can be there for you. How do you see things moving forward with him?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I think we'll just take things slow. I'm not sure how much time I can commit with everything else going on."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Taking it slow sounds like a good plan. It's important to prioritize what feels manageable."}]

My therapist has really helped me gain perspective on my relationships.\\nsupporter: That sounds like a great idea. Having professional guidance can really clarify things.
